sources.title: Torus link homology
sources.version_status: arXiv:1909.00418v1, 1 September 2019. The recorded 10 October 2026 arXiv metadata read listed only v1. No journal-PDF comparison or journal-publication claim is made.
sources.recorded_inspection: The proof source review inspected text on PDF pages 3–4 and 7–10 and visually checked degree-zero R on PDF page 9 and Markov/unknot formulas on page 10. The audit inspected PDF pages 3, 9 and 10.
sources.source_role: Corollary 1.4 supplies positive-torus parity; sections 2.2–2.3 supply exact grading and positive-Markov conventions. Remark 1.13 is a consistency check; the report proves the needed invariant-coordinate factor independently.
sources.provenance_limit: The negative-torus warning in Remark 1.5 remains relevant. No assertion about all signed torus links or all positive braids follows from the credited theorem.

bounded_search_scope: The recorded current searches combined parity, braids, partial twists, preservation, Jucys–Murphy and 10_139. They did not establish a prior statement of the exact infinite family. This bounded search is not exhaustive and does not certify novelty.
source_inspection_limits: Recorded source-page checks support the stated conventions, credited parity theorem and scope distinctions. The long source proofs were not independently re-proved in edition preparation. The general characterization and eventual central-full-twist questions remain unresolved by this work.
